about: The bounded source set and catalog evidence a prior step gathered for this design decision.
objective: Add a Moltbook opportunity scan to an existing governed pipeline.

decomposition.objective_summary: Add a Moltbook opportunity scan step.

sources.excerpt: methods: scan-provider reads Moltbook newest posts and finds at most one opportunity, cited to its posts; scan finds at most one opportunity in a feed snapshot already captured, for replay or offline work, from objective, community_context and feed_snapshot; post drafts a post for the opportunity a scan chose; publish publishes a drafted post once after exact approval.
